question: Does preloading the landing page's web fonts remove its layout shift, and what does it cost on a slow connection?
setup: Local build through vite preview, Chromium 156. Layout shift: Landing at 1440x900 on a 10 Mbit/s, 40 ms network. Low-end: 390x844, 4x CPU slowdown, Slow 3G; medians of 3 runs.
decision: Not kept: preloading slows the first data on every page by 1.5-2 s on Slow 3G to fix a shift on one desktop page.
